15	### Prerequisites

17	Before you begin, you'll need to [download and install the Shopify CLI](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/tools/cli/getting-started) if you haven't already.

28	shopify app dev

40	export async function loader({ request }) {
41	  const { admin } = await shopify.authenticate.admin(request);
42	
43	  const response = await admin.graphql(`
44	    {
45	      products(first: 25) {
46	        nodes {
47	          title
48	          description
49	        }
50	      }
51	    }`);
52	
53	  const {
54	    data: {
55	      products: { nodes },

57	  } = await response.json();
58	
59	  return nodes;
60	}
61	```

Please see [/app/routes/app.\_index.tsx](https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-template-react-router/blob/main/app/routes/app._index.tsx) and [shopify.app.toml](https://github.com/Shopify/shopify-app-template-react-router/blob/main/shopify.app.toml).
